notes: Fan chapters c001-c005 plus c005.5 against the Kodansha digital volume 1, compiled by danke-Empire. FIVE cards, all 752x700 and all at the START of a chapter - local index 1 in four of five, local 2 in the first. Page indices here are the SIDECAR's member order, which is not the shell's: c005.5 sorts before c005 in a glob, so the last card is page 157 and not the 166 a glob reports. SIGNAL 1 FINDS NONE OF THEM, because its rule is 'at a member's LAST index', and this is a direct counterexample to UnpairedRun's doc claim that 'the first-index version is zero for four - what accumulates at a member's start is front matter', which was measured on gotoubun-v01 alone. PAGE 189 (c005.5 local 8) IS NOT A CARD and must not be skipped: it is an OFFICIAL page of c005.5 carrying translator credits typeset onto it, full size at 869x1300 and page-shaped, so the size rule leaves it alone by construction rather than by luck. It is the official-page analogue of the credits-on-a-story-page ceiling notes.md already records. Aligned SOUND at 182 whole pairings. Adjudicated by the owner over every page either rule flagged plus every chapter-final page. NOT exhaustively swept, so credit_pages is a floor and this edition contributes to precision only.
